title: ChaCha Remote Operator MCP — self-hosted governed remote operations
problem: ChaCha DEV needs a first-party zero-license-cost remote route that cannot bypass canonical routing, Guardian, Sentinelle, STOP or the existing Direct Operator when used for functional BUILD handoff.
goals: Preserve the qualified bounded Remote Operator READ surface as the owned preferred remote route when capability, health and policy permit.
Add a separate functional-intent handoff through the existing Direct Operator M2M ingress without granting technical decision or mutation authority to the MCP.
Keep Remote Operations and Functional Intent as distinct authority classes.
Make route preference and fallback derive from the canonical route-authority contract rather than client or agent choice.
Preserve Guardian, Sentinelle, Bastion, canonical STOP, CCR, UMG, lifecycle, append-only evidence and zero automatic external spend.
Keep transport, authentication, routing, functional handoff and machine-operation policy as separate governed layers.
Remain capability/contract/schema driven and version agnostic.
non_goals: Do not expose unrestricted shell, arbitrary argv, arbitrary HTTP, credentials or secret stores.
Do not impersonate a Tailscale user or fabricate identity headers.
Do not create a second Direct Operator or another operational source of truth.
Do not let Remote MCP call central-orchestrator or a provider directly for functional BUILD execution.
Do not grant technical decision, direct execution, direct mutation, production or destructive authority to the Remote MCP.
Do not convert policy denial, STOP or unavailable security gates into a fallback route.
Do not auto-purchase hosting, identity, tunnel or SaaS services.

current_change.purpose: Converge Remote Operator V0.3, Direct Operator M2M ingress and conversational exposure under one canonical route-authority contract.

acceptance_criteria: Remote governed READ and functional BUILD handoff use separate agents and Guardian authority contracts.
Remote MCP remains loopback-bound and raw command execution remains disabled.
Functional handoff follows Remote MCP -> Direct Operator M2M -> Central Orchestrator -> Scheduler -> Run Controller -> registered adapter.
M2M authentication is service-identity based, HMAC signed, replay-protected and never spoofs Tailscale identity.
Only POST /api/v1/m2m/intent and GET /api/v1/m2m/jobs/<owned-job> are allowed by the M2M service contract.
Canonical STOP or unreadable STOP authority blocks submission.
Unknown route, policy denial or security-gate failure fails closed and does not select fallback.
Fallback may be proposed only when predeclared and must preserve or reduce authority.
CCR discovers the Remote Operator project runtime from its materialization manifest.
UMG accepts persistent PLATFORM runtime infrastructure only with health, rollback, retention and purge contracts.
No production activation, tunnel materialization, secret materialization or platform/current switch is part of this change.
architecture_invariants: GitHub remains source-code and CI authority.
ChaCha DEV on ChaChaVPS remains runtime technical orchestrator and operational source of truth.
Canonical route-authority is the routing authority; individual agents and clients cannot invent bypasses.
Remote READ and functional BUILD handoff are separate authority classes.
MCP transport, exposure transport, M2M authentication and machine-operation policy remain separate layers.
Producer and verifier responsibilities remain separated.
Capabilities, contracts, schemas and manifests are preferred to major-version branching.
